messages.content:
## 00 · Start Here 设计任务
LEVEL L2 · DESIGN TASK · v2
Run & Earn — a running app that pays you in points
Design a dark-mode mobile app that turns steps into points: onboarding and sign-in, a home dashboard with today’s run and step stats, run history, a points store, and withdrawing points to a bank account. iPhone, 375 × 812, dark mode. Work in your own new Figma file — this file is read-only reference.
How to work
1. Build exactly the 10 frames below, named exactly as listed (one state per frame), and wire them as a clickable prototype with the listed links.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in page order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The brand color and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii, elevation and the page grid, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button, a default Text Field and the platform shell. Design all other states, the headers, the bottom navigation, the modal and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the logo, the illustrations, the photos, the avatars and badges, the third-party logos and the icons from 04 · Media. Store brands are shown as text wordmarks — there are no brand logo files.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
Frames · goals · must include · links
Frame names are fixed. Must-include lists are grouped by subject and sorted A–Z: they state what is on the screen, never where it goes or how it looks.
01_Get_Started
Goal: Introduce the app on first launch.
MUST INCLUDE
• Body “Run and earn with our app.”
• Full-bleed artwork Illustration_Runners
• Heading “Running App”
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• “Get Started” (Button)
LINKS
Get Started → 02_Onboarding
02_Onboarding
Goal: Explain the idea before sign-in.
MUST INCLUDE
• Back (Icon_Arrow_Left) · “Skip”
• Body “Track every step of your run and turn it into points you can spend in the store.”
• Illustration_Onboarding_Run
• Page indicator: 3 pages · current: 2
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Title “Run”
• “Already have an account? Sign In”
• “Next” (Icon_Arrow_Right)
LINKS
Back → 01_Get_Started
Next, Skip or Sign In → 03_Log_In
03_Log_In
Goal: Sign in to an existing account.
MUST INCLUDE
• Back (Icon_Arrow_Left)
• Email field filled with “dani@example.com”
• Heading “Log In”
• Logo_App
• Password field with placeholder “Password” and show / hide (Icon_Eye_Closed)
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• “Forgot Password?”
• “Log In” (Button)
• “New User? Sign Up”
• “Or continue with” · Google (Logo_Google) · Facebook (Logo_Facebook) · Twitter (Logo_Twitter)
• “Remember Me” checkbox · checked
LINKS
Back → 02_Onboarding
Log In → 05_Home
Sign Up → 04_Verify_Email
04_Verify_Email
Goal: Confirm the email address of a new account.
MUST INCLUDE
• 4-digit code input · first digit “3” entered, three empty
• Back (Icon_Arrow_Left)
• Body “We’ve sent a 4-digit code to the email associated with your account. Enter it to verify.”
• Heading “Verify your email”
• Illustration_Verify_Email
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• “Open mail app”
• “Verify Email” (Button)
LINKS
Back → 03_Log_In
Verify Email → 05_Home
05_Home
Goal: See today’s progress and recent runs at a glance.
MUST INCLUDE
• Bottom navigation (icons only): Home (Icon_Nav_Home) · Challenges (Icon_Nav_Challenges) · Store (Icon_Nav_Store) · Profile (Icon_Nav_Profile) · current: Home
• Daily goal: “14,000 / 15,000 steps” with progress bar · “Level 5” · Badge_Level
• Header: menu (Icon_Menu) · Avatar_Daniela · “HELLO!” · “Daniela” · inbox (Icon_Inbox) · notifications with unread dot (Icon_Notification)
• History: “History” · “See All” · 4 history rows (see DATA · History, rows 1–4)
• Promo banner: “Share & Get” · “Get 2x points for every step, only valid for today” · “Share” (Icon_Share) · Illustration_Share
• Stat cards: “53,524” Steps (Icon_Steps) · “1000” Earned Points (Icon_Coin)
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Today card: Avatar_Run_Today · “28 May” · “Today” · timer “01 : 09 : 44” · ring “2345 / 5000” (Icon_Run)
LINKS
See All → 06_History
Earned Points card → 09_New_Wallet
Store → 07_Store
06_History
Goal: Review past days.
MUST INCLUDE
• 7 history rows with date, distance, kcal, steps and earned points where present (see DATA · History)
• Header: back (Icon_Back_Square) · “History” · inbox (Icon_Inbox) · notifications with unread dot (Icon_Notification)
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Summary: “18,3 H” Time (Icon_Timer) · “48,7 KM” Distance (Icon_Distance) · “123 BPM” Heart Beat (Icon_Heart_Rate)
LINKS
Back → 05_Home
07_Store
Goal: Spend points on gear.
MUST INCLUDE
• Bottom navigation (icons only): Home (Icon_Nav_Home) · Challenges (Icon_Nav_Challenges) · Store (Icon_Nav_Store) · Profile (Icon_Nav_Profile) · current: Store
• Brands: 7 brand tiles as text wordmarks + “See All” (see DATA · Store)
• Categories: 6 round photo shortcuts New · Men · Women · Kids · Equip · Nutrition (Photo_Category_New … Nutrition)
• Header: back (Icon_Back_Square) · “Store” · inbox (Icon_Inbox) · notifications with unread dot (Icon_Notification)
• Popular: “Popular” · “See All” · 2 product cards with photo, brand, name and points price (Icon_Coin) (see DATA · Store)
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• Today’s special: 2 offer cards, horizontally scrollable, each “Today’s Special” · “Get 2x points for every step, only valid for today” · “x2” · Illustration_Special
LINKS
Back or Home → 05_Home
Product card → 08_Address_Empty
08_Address_Empty
Goal: Tell the user a delivery address is needed.
MUST INCLUDE
• Empty state: Illustration_Address · “Add your address” · “Unfortunately we don’t know where to deliver your items to you”
• Header: back (Icon_Back_Square) · “Address” · inbox (Icon_Inbox) · notifications with unread dot (Icon_Notification)
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
• “Add Address”
LINKS
Back → 07_Store
09_New_Wallet
Goal: Choose how to withdraw points.
MUST INCLUDE
• 2 option rows with icon, title, description and chevron (Icon_Chevron_Right): Bank Account (Icon_Bank) · Card (Icon_Card) — description for both “Unfortunately we don’t know where to send your money”
• Header: back (Icon_Back_Square) · “New Wallet” · inbox (Icon_Inbox) · notifications with unread dot (Icon_Notification)
• Heading “Select the withdrawal type”
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
LINKS
Back → 05_Home
Bank Account → 10_Account_Updated
10_Account_Updated
Goal: Confirm that the bank account details were saved.
MUST INCLUDE
• Behind the modal (dimmed): header back (Icon_Back_Square) · “Select Account” · 3 bank account rows with bank icon (Icon_Bank_Small), name, masked number and edit (Icon_Edit) (see DATA · Accounts) · “Add New Account”
• Modal: Icon_Account_Updated · “Account Updated” · “Your account details have been successfully changed” · “Ok” (Button)
• Status bar and home indicator (from 02 · Components)
LINKS
Ok → 05_Home
Navigation structure
• Start: 01_Get_Started → 02_Onboarding → 03_Log_In → 05_Home; new users: 03_Log_In → Sign Up → 04_Verify_Email → 05_Home.
• Bottom navigation on 05 and 07 — order: Home · Challenges · Store · Profile (icons only, no labels).
• History: 05_Home → See All → 06_History.
• Store: 07_Store → product → 08_Address_Empty (no delivery address saved yet).
• Withdraw: 05_Home → Earned Points → 09_New_Wallet → Bank Account → 10_Account_Updated → Ok → 05_Home.
• Entry only (no frame): Challenges and Profile tabs, menu, inbox, notifications, Forgot Password, Remember Me, social sign-in, Open mail app, Share, category shortcuts, offer cards, brand tiles, See All (Store), Add Address, Card, edit account, Add New Account.
Fixed data & copy
Use these values verbatim.
History (newest first)
1 · 27 May · 11,120 steps · 12,4 km · 1222 kcal
2 · 26 May · 11,120 steps · 12,4 km · 1222 kcal
3 · 25 May · 10,120 steps · 100 pt · 12,4 km · 1222 kcal
4 · 24 May · 11,120 steps · 12,4 km · 1222 kcal
5 · 23 May · 10,120 steps · 100 pt · 12,4 km · 1222 kcal
6 · 22 May · 11,120 steps · 12,4 km · 1222 kcal
7 · 21 May · 10,120 steps · 100 pt · 12,4 km · 1222 kcal
05_Home shows rows 1–4.
Store
Brand tiles (in order): Stride · Pacer · Vela · Trio · Arma · Kinetix · Novo · See All
Popular products:
1 · Photo_Shoe_1 · Vela · Court Classic Low · 1200 points
2 · Photo_Shoe_2 · Vela · Lunar Runner 1 · 1200 points
Accounts (Select Account)
1 · Harbor Bank · “Default” tag · 1287 •••• 0832
2 · Crescent Islamic Bank · 4410 •••• 1975
3 · Union Gulf Bank · 6023 •••• 5518
User
Daniela · dani@example.com · Level 5 · daily goal 15,000 steps
What is fixed · what is yours
Fixed (given)
• Frame names and the links listed per frame
• Must-include content (what, not how)
• All data and copy
• Brand color #7B61FF and Poppins; dark mode
• Media: logo, illustrations, photos, avatars and badges, third-party logos, icons
• Default Button, default Text Field, status bar and home indicator
Yours (designer decides)
• Layout, grouping, order and emphasis on every screen
• All other colors: background and surface darks, text, points / reward accent, progress and ring, success, notification dot, offer-card and tile colors, error / disabled
• Type scale (including whether numerals get a display face), spacing, radii, elevation
• All states: checked checkbox, current page, current tab, filled / empty code boxes, dimmed background behind the modal
• Headers, bottom navigation, modal, progress bar, today card and ring, stat cards, promo banner, history rows, summary bar, category shortcuts, offer cards, brand tiles, product cards, empty state, option rows, account rows, code input
How it is evaluated
Your file is compared with this brief on coverage, data and flow — not on visual similarity to any original.
1. Checklist coverage per frame
2. Data & copy accuracy
3. Flow & prototype completeness
4. Information hierarchy
5. Visual quality & consistency of your own system
6. Component reuse
Deliverable: the link to your own Figma file containing the 10 named frames, your components and the prototype.
## 01 · Foundations 视觉规范
Foundations · Run & Earn
Fixed: the brand color and the typeface below (the app logo is in 04 · Media). The app is dark mode. Everything else is yours to define and apply consistently: background and surface darks, text colors, the points / reward accent, progress and ring colors, success, notification dot, category and special-offer card colors, selected / current states, disabled, type scale, spacing, radii and elevation.
Brand color
Brand primary · violet
#7B61FF
The app’s signature accent (primary actions, progress, links). Where and how much to use it is your decision.
Typeface
Aa Bb Cc 0123456789  53,524
Use Poppins for all UI text. The source sets the big stat numbers (53,524 · 1000 · 18,3 H) in a condensed display face (Bebas Neue) and two small labels in Lato / Open Sans — you may use a display face for numerals if you want; Poppins alone is fine. Sizes, weights and line heights are yours to define as a consistent type scale.
Canvas: 375 × 812 (iPhone X/11 Pro). Dark mode. 05_Home and 06_History may scroll vertically — frame height is free.

function.name: mcp__figma__get_screenshot
function.description: Generate a screenshot for a given node or the currently selected node in the Figma desktop app. Works on Figma design files (URL path `/design/`), FigJam boards (`/board/`), and Figma Slides (`/slides/`). The optional `maxDimension` parameter (positive integer, max 65536, default 1024) caps the longer edge of the rendered PNG in pixels — increase it when you need to inspect fine detail, decrease it for thumbnails or to save context. The JSON metadata entry in the response includes both `width`/`height` (the rendered PNG size) and `original_width`/`original_height` (the node's natural canvas size before any clamping), so callers can decide whether to re-request at a higher `maxDimension`. Use the nodeId parameter to specify a node id. nodeId parameter is REQUIRED. Use the fileKey parameter to specify the file key. fileKey parameter is REQUIRED. If a URL is provided, extract the file key and node id from the URL. For example, if given the URL https://figma.com/design/pqrs/ExampleFile?node-id=1-2 the extracted fileKey would be `pqrs` and the extracted nodeId would be `1:2`. If the URL does not include `node-id`, ask the user for a node-specific URL. Do not pass an empty or guessed nodeId. This tool is not supported for Figma Make Files (URLs containing `/make/`). By default this tool returns a short-lived URL to the screenshot plus curl instructions for downloading the PNG — the URL+curl path is strongly preferred because it uses far fewer tokens than embedding the image inline. The `enableBase64Response` parameter defaults to `false`. Only set `enableBase64Response: true` when the agent cannot fetch URLs (no shell access, no HTTP client, or a sandboxed environment that blocks outbound requests); when set, an inline base64 image entry is appended to the response in addition to the URL and curl instructions. If the URL is of the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName then use the branchKey as the fileKey.

sessionId.description: After create_session succeeds, pass its exact returned UUID here on every file-tool call for this task, even when fileKey differs.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node in the Figma document, eg. "123:456" or "123-456". This should be a valid node ID in the Figma document. Do not pass an empty string for node_id.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to use. If the URL is provided, extract the file key from the URL. The given URL must be in the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:int1-:int2. The extracted fileKey would be `:fileKey`.

contentsOnly.description: When true, renders the node in isolation — floating/overlapping content (e.g. connectors parented to the page that visually sit above a section) is excluded. Defaults to false so screenshots match what the user sees on the canvas. Only set to true if the caller specifically needs the isolated render.

enableBase64Response.description: When true, the response also includes the screenshot inline as a base64-encoded image entry, in addition to the short-lived URL and curl instructions. Defaults to false. Set to true ONLY if the agent cannot fetch URLs (no shell access, no HTTP client, or a sandboxed environment that blocks outbound requests)

maxDimension.description: Optional. Maximum pixel size of the longer edge of the rendered screenshot — the server scales the node so that max(width, height) ≤ maxDimension while preserving aspect ratio. Defaults to 1024. Must be a positive integer; values above 65536 are rejected. Increase when the agent will visually inspect fine detail; decrease for thumbnails or to save context.

function.name: mcp__figma__get_metadata
function.description: IMPORTANT: Always prefer to use get_design_context tool. Get metadata for a node or page in the Figma desktop app in XML format. Useful only for getting an overview of the structure, it only includes node IDs, layer types, names, positions and sizes. You can call get_design_context on the node IDs contained in this response. Use the nodeId parameter to specify a node id, it can also be the page id (e.g. 0:1). IMPORTANT: This tool only works for Figma design files (URL path `/design/`). It is NOT supported for FigJam (`/board/`) or Slides (`/slides/`) files. This tool is not supported for Figma Make Files (URLs containing `/make/`). The nodeId parameter is optional: when omitted, the tool returns a list of the top-level pages (guid + name) in the document instead of an XML dump — use this when you don't yet know which page or node to drill into. When the user has a current selection relevant to the request, the response is prepended with a "Currently selected nodes:" block listing the selection by guid and name, so you can tell whether it matches the queried nodeId. If the URL includes `node-id`, extract it and pass it as nodeId; for example, if given the URL https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=1-2, the extracted nodeId would be `1:2`. If the URL does not include `node-id`, do not set nodeId; omit the field so the tool lists top-level pages. Do not pass an empty or guessed nodeId. If the URL is of the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName then use the branchKey as the fileKey.

sessionId.description: After create_session succeeds, pass its exact returned UUID here on every file-tool call for this task, even when fileKey differs.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node in the Figma document, eg. "123:456" or "123-456". This should be a valid node ID in the Figma document. Do not pass an empty string for node_id.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to use. If the URL is provided, extract the file key from the URL. The given URL must be in the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:int1-:int2. The extracted fileKey would be `:fileKey`.

function.name: mcp__figma__use_figma
function.description:
Create, edit, generate, or sync any design in Figma — UIs, screens, mockups, components, frames, variables, styles, text, images, layouts, and design systems. This general-purpose tool writes to Figma with JavaScript via the Figma Plugin API. Works on Figma design files (URL path `/design/`), FigJam boards (`/board/`), and Figma Slides (`/slides/`).

IMPORTANT: Before calling this tool, load figma-use guidance — prefer the /figma-use skill if available, otherwise read the skill://figma/figma-use/SKILL.md MCP resource if available. Skipping this causes common, hard-to-debug failures.

Use this tool when the user wants to:
- Create or generate a Figma design, screen, UI, or mockup from scratch, intent, or code
- Update, edit, or sync an existing Figma design
- Generate or sync Figma designs from source code
- Set up or modify design tokens, variables, or styles
- Build or extend a design system or component/variant library
- Fix layout, spacing, auto-layout, or fill/hug issues
- Add component descriptions, annotations and Code Connect metadata to nodes
- Review or fix accessibility, contrast, typography, or visual polish
- Inspect or query node properties programmatically
CHOOSING BETWEEN use_figma AND generate_figma_design:
- Default to use_figma for all write operations
- Exception: generate_figma_design ONLY to capture a web app page/view for the first time. For web apps, run both in parallel — generate_figma_design captures a pixel-perfect screenshot, use_figma builds from imported design system components and refines against the screenshot
- Non-web (iOS, Android, generic UI) and from-scratch designs: use_figma only
- Updating/syncing a Figma page already captured: use_figma — even if source code changed
GOTCHAS
- For the font "Inter", the style is "Semi Bold", not "SemiBold" and "Extra Bold" not "ExtraBold"
- MUST use `await figma.setCurrentPageAsync(page)` to change pages. Setting figma.currentPage is not supported
- MUST NEVER use loadAllPagesAsync,setPluginData,createImageAsync. They are not supported API

sessionId.description: After create_session succeeds, pass its exact returned UUID here on every file-tool call for this task, even when fileKey differs.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to use. If the URL is provided, extract the file key from the URL. The given URL must be in the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:int1-:int2. The extracted fileKey would be `:fileKey`.

code.description: JavaScript code to execute. Has access to the `figma` global (Figma Plugin API)

description.description: A concise description of what the code aims to do

skillNames.description: A comma-separated list of Figma skill names being followed, if any (e.g. "figma-use", "figma-use,figma-generate-design"). Only pass this when explicitly instructed to by skill documentation. Used for logging purposes. If the skill was loaded via a skill-content MCP resource, prefix the skill name with "resource:". (e.g. "resource:figma-use", "resource:figma-use,resource:figma-generate-design")
